title: haven: KeyMaterialResponse decoder accepts one client only, refuses partialSuccess with a success client
description: Found by A2 (mimid-1wgh.46.1.2). protocol-06 §5.2 L1163-1168: partialSuccess = key material returned for some clients, and each client is enumerated (clients<V> vector); L1283-1284: partialSuccess means key material for at least one client. Haven mimi-core 2c14e62 KeyMaterialResponse::decode (src/protocol_wire.rs ~1196-1294) reads only clients[0] (trailing-bytes error after it) and accepts only (Success,Success), (PartialSuccess,KeyMaterialExhausted) and denials; everything else is 'unsupported (userStatus, clientStatus) combination'. mimid's spec-valid response (partialSuccess; bob-phone success + bob-laptop keyMaterialExhausted) fails with '(PartialSuccess, Success)'. Same root as mimid-1wgh.46.1.7 (Haven's KeyMaterialResponse models a single client). Vector: /home/mark/Cache/mimid-haven-xcheck/vectors/key_material_response_partial_success.bin. Report to havenmessenger/interop only with Mark's per-action OK.
notes: 2026-11-02: reported to Haven with Mark's OK in the combined cross-check comment: https://github.com/havenmessenger/interop/issues/1#issuecomment-6588377664 (offered fix-or-DIVERGENCES per their CONTRIBUTING.md). Leave open until Haven fixes or documents it.
